test_case.test_name: AMD GPU deferred poison non-fatal decode and cleanup
test_case.purpose: Inject one approved deferred poison into a verified disposable allocation on one explicit GPU, prove bounded consumer Bus error and a fresh complete non-fatal table6.4 record, then clear poison and restore process, data, GPU and host health.
required_package: Approved amdgpuras build and full AMD table6.4 schema
Proof block2/type8/device2 implements the intended deferred poison and reconciliation with SDMA Script
Explicit UUID/BDF/OAM/socket/device2 map and device2 freshness baseline
Disposable process/allocation/VMID/logical/physical address ownership with data boundaries
Bus-error scope, no-fatal/no-reset oracle, poison clear, recovery and restoration procedure
test_case.test_command: Do not inject until component, target, allocation and cleanup are approved. Then bind one explicit GPU and disposable allocation, capture device2 decode/poison/data/OOB baseline, execute the reviewed tuple once, correlate returned addresses/VMID and bounded consumer Bus error, decode the complete record and perform owner-controlled cleanup with no retry.
test_case.expected_result: Only the authorized disposable allocation consumes the poison and its intended process receives the bounded Bus error; a fresh complete target-specific Uncorrected Non-fatal/MCE record appears with no fatal/reset escalation, and poison/page/process/data/GPU/host state is fully restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until type/component, allocation ownership and full schema are authoritative. Unknown address/VMID, unrelated process effect, fatal/reset escalation, stale/partial decode, persistent poison, data mismatch or incomplete recovery fails/BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle GPU/host with disposable verified data and independent OOB.
Confirm process/allocation/VMID/address ownership before one poison injection.
No shared driver reload or evidence clear without approval.
Abort on wrong target/address, unrelated impact, fatal severity, reset/hang or evidence loss; never retry.
expected_evidence: UUID/BDF/device2 plus process/allocation/VMID/address ownership and data hash
Device2 decode cursor, poison/page/log and OOB baseline
Exact one-shot transcript with returned addresses/VMID and scoped Bus error
Fresh complete table6.4 non-fatal decode with no fatal escalation
Poison clear, process/data/GPU/host health, restoration diff and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Preserve the first poison and decode evidence, then use the approved page/process/GPU cleanup. Restore tool/driver/debug state, verify poison/page state is clear, disposable data outcome is understood, all GPUs and host are healthy. Do not repeat the event.
